description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between BLEU score and average lagging (AL) for four different models: Consistency-CE, Inconsistency-CE, Inconsistency-CE-MP, and Consistency-Bi. The x-axis represents the average lagging, ranging from 2.5 to 11.0, with tick marks at intervals of 2.5. The y-axis represents the BLEU score, ranging from 25 to 33, with tick marks at intervals of 1. Each model is represented by a distinct line style and color: Consistency-CE is shown with a light purple dotted line and circle markers, Inconsistency-CE with a dark purple dashed line and square markers, Inconsistency-CE-MP with a blue dash-dotted line and square markers, and Consistency-Bi with a red solid line and star markers. All four lines show an increasing trend in BLEU score as average lagging increases. At an average lagging of 2.5, the BLEU scores are approximately 25.8 for Consistency-CE, 25.9 for Inconsistency-CE, 26.1 for Inconsistency-CE-MP, and 28.7 for Consistency-Bi. By the time average lagging reaches 11.0, the BLEU scores are approximately 31.7 for Consistency-CE, 31.7 for Inconsistency-CE, 32.0 for Inconsistency-CE-MP, and 32.1 for Consistency-Bi. The Consistency-Bi model consistently achieves the highest BLEU score across all values of average lagging, while the Consistency-CE model consistently achieves the lowest.
